title: Detailed armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x='22' y='16' width='56' height='46' rx='12' fill='#d64b4b'/>
  <!-- backrest inner cushion -->
  <rect x='28' y='21' width='44' height='33' rx='8' fill='#ef6b6b'/>
  <!-- backrest top highlight -->
  <rect x='33' y='24' width='34' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <rect x='12' y='38' width='16' height='38' rx='8' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <!-- left arm top -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='40' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#e85c5c'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <rect x='72' y='38' width='16' height='38' rx='8' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <!-- right arm top -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='40' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#e85c5c'/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x='22' y='54' width='56' height='22' rx='7' fill='#ff7a4d'/>
  <!-- seat cushion top highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='56' width='48' height='7' rx='4' fill='#ffa06e'/>
  <!-- seat cushion front detail -->
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e8633a'/>
  <!-- front panel -->
  <rect x='22' y='70' width='56' height='12' rx='4' fill='#a83232'/>
  <!-- front panel lighter strip -->
  <rect x='28' y='72' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c94a4a'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x='26' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#6b3a1f'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x='66' y='82' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#6b3a1f'/>
  <!-- back leg hint left -->
  <rect x='34' y='82' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#54301a'/>
  <!-- back leg hint right -->
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#54301a'/>
  <!-- left arm inner edge highlight -->
  <rect x='24' y='44' width='3' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#f07373'/>
  <!-- right arm inner edge highlight -->
  <rect x='73' y='44' width='3' height='28' rx='1.5' fill='#f07373'/>
  <!-- small button tufts on backrest -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='35' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='2' fill='#c43d3d'/>
</svg>
